titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Tourism plays an important role in the Tunisian economy. Every year, millions of tourists visit our country to enjoy its beautiful beaches, its historical sites and its warm hospitality. Tourism creates thousands of jobs, from hotels and restaurants to guides and craftsmen. It also helps to make Tunisia known around the world. However, tourism can have negative effects if it is not well managed. Too many visitors can damage fragile sites and pollute the environment. Moreover, some regions depend too much on tourism and suffer when the number of tourists falls. Therefore, Tunisia should develop a responsible tourism that protects both its natural beauty and its cultural heritage for future generations.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Why do tourists visit Tunisia? Give two reasons.   (2 marks)
2) Give two positive effects of tourism mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
3) Give two negative effects of badly managed tourism.   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the passive: "Millions of tourists visit our country."   (2 marks)
2) Complete with "should": Tunisia ______ develop responsible tourism.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (however / because): Tourism creates jobs; ______, it can damage the environment.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "protect" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Is tourism good or bad for a country like Tunisia?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with advantages and disadvantages. Use linkers.
